stem: Which statement explains the historical significance of the Tuskegee Airmen?

options.label: A
options.text: They introduced new tactics for use during aerial combat missions.

options.label: B
options.text: They overcame racial barriers and discrimination to serve as fighter pilots.

options.label: C
options.text: They overcame criticism for flying the airplanes that dropped the atomic bombs.

options.label: D
options.text: They gathered valuable information by flying nighttime aerial reconnaissance missions.
